## Setup - Run in console

```{r setup_wru, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
# Required packages
required_pkgs <- c(
  "readr", "dplyr", "stringr", "purrr", "wru",
  "future", "future.callr", "haven"
)

missing_pkgs <- required_pkgs[!vapply(required_pkgs, requireNamespace, quietly = TRUE, FUN.VALUE = logical(1))]
if (length(missing_pkgs) > 0) {
  options(timeout = 600)
  install.packages(missing_pkgs, repos = "https://cloud.r-project.org")
}

still_missing <- required_pkgs[!vapply(required_pkgs, requireNamespace, quietly = TRUE, FUN.VALUE = logical(1))]
if (length(still_missing) > 0) {
  stop(paste("Missing required R packages:", paste(still_missing, collapse = ", ")))
}

library(readr)
library(dplyr)
library(stringr)
library(purrr)
library(wru)
library(future)
library(future.callr)
library(haven)

# Parallel backend
future::plan(future.callr::callr)

# Find project root by walking up until we find Data/
.dir <- getwd()
while (!dir.exists(file.path(.dir, "Data")) && .dir != dirname(.dir)) {
  .dir <- dirname(.dir)
}
parent_dir <- .dir
method_inputs_dir <- file.path(parent_dir, "Data", "interim", "method_inputs")
predictions_dir <- file.path(parent_dir, "Data", "interim", "predictions")
processed_dir <- file.path(parent_dir, "Data", "interim", "processed_PPP")
dir.create(method_inputs_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
dir.create(predictions_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

# PPP step-style dataset names
input_file <- "PPP_wru_interim.dta"
output_file <- "PPP_wru_interim_prediction.dta"

# Optional manual overrides
name_col_override <- NULL
state_col_override <- NULL
zip_col_override <- NULL
race_col_override <- NULL
```

```{r load_data, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
# Read WRU interim file from clean step
in_path <- file.path(method_inputs_dir, input_file)
raw_df <- NULL

if (file.exists(in_path)) {
  raw_df <- haven::read_dta(in_path)
} else {
  csv_fallback <- file.path(processed_dir, "PPP_clean.csv")
  dta_fallback <- file.path(processed_dir, "PPP_clean.dta")

  if (file.exists(csv_fallback)) {
    message("PPP_wru_interim.dta not found; using fallback PPP_clean.csv and creating interim id.")
    raw_df <- readr::read_csv(csv_fallback, show_col_types = FALSE)
  } else if (file.exists(dta_fallback)) {
    message("PPP_wru_interim.dta not found; using fallback PPP_clean.dta and creating interim id.")
    raw_df <- haven::read_dta(dta_fallback)
  } else {
    stop(paste0(
      "Input file not found: ", in_path,
      "\nFallback files also missing: ", csv_fallback, " and ", dta_fallback
    ))
  }

  if (!"id" %in% names(raw_df)) {
    raw_df <- raw_df %>% dplyr::mutate(id = dplyr::row_number())
  }

  haven::write_dta(raw_df, in_path)
  message("Wrote fallback interim file: ", in_path)
}

cat("Rows:", nrow(raw_df), " Columns:", ncol(raw_df), "\n")
cat("Column names:\n")
print(names(raw_df))
cat("\nPreview:\n")
print(utils::head(raw_df, 5))
```

```{r detect_columns, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
normalize_name <- function(x) {
  stringr::str_to_lower(gsub("[^a-z0-9]", "", x))
}

pick_column <- function(df, override, candidates, label) {
  if (!is.null(override)) {
    if (!override %in% names(df)) {
      stop(sprintf("Override for %s not found: %s", label, override))
    }
    return(override)
  }

  nms <- names(df)
  norm <- normalize_name(nms)
  cand_norm <- unique(normalize_name(candidates))

  exact_idx <- match(cand_norm, norm)
  exact_idx <- exact_idx[!is.na(exact_idx)]
  if (length(exact_idx) > 0) return(nms[exact_idx[1]])

  # Fallback: partial contains match
  for (pat in cand_norm) {
    hit <- which(stringr::str_detect(norm, pat))
    if (length(hit) > 0) return(nms[hit[1]])
  }

  NULL
}

name_col <- pick_column(
  raw_df,
  name_col_override,
  c("BorrowerName", "name", "full_name", "fullname", "applicant_name", "owner_name"),
  "name"
)

state_col <- pick_column(
  raw_df,
  state_col_override,
  c("state", "BorrowerState", "st", "state_cd", "statecode"),
  "state"
)

zip_col <- pick_column(
  raw_df,
  zip_col_override,
  c("BorrowerZip", "zip", "zipcode", "zip_code", "zcta", "zcta5"),
  "zip"
)

race_col <- pick_column(
  raw_df,
  race_col_override,
  c("Race", "race", "self_reported_race", "Race_Ethnicity_Simple"),
  "race"
)

surname_col <- pick_column(
  raw_df,
  NULL,
  c("surname", "last_name", "lastname"),
  "surname"
)

if (is.null(state_col) || is.null(zip_col) || (is.null(surname_col) && is.null(name_col))) {
  stop(paste(
    "No usable name/surname, state, or zip columns found.",
    "Detected:",
    paste0("name_col=", ifelse(is.null(name_col), "NULL", name_col)),
    paste0("surname_col=", ifelse(is.null(surname_col), "NULL", surname_col)),
    paste0("state_col=", ifelse(is.null(state_col), "NULL", state_col)),
    paste0("zip_col=", ifelse(is.null(zip_col), "NULL", zip_col))
  ))
}

cat("Detected columns:\n")
cat("  surname_col:", ifelse(is.null(surname_col), "<derive from name>", surname_col), "\n")
cat("  name_col:", ifelse(is.null(name_col), "<none>", name_col), "\n")
cat("  state_col:", state_col, "\n")
cat("  zip_col:", zip_col, "\n")
cat("  race_col:", ifelse(is.null(race_col), "<none>", race_col), "\n")
```

```{r clean_fields, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
# Stable id (preserve existing id if present)
if ("id" %in% names(raw_df)) {
  work_df <- raw_df %>%
    dplyr::mutate(id = as.integer(id))
} else {
  work_df <- raw_df %>%
    dplyr::mutate(id = dplyr::row_number())
}

# State cleaning: handle abbreviation / full name / FIPS
orig_state <- stringr::str_trim(as.character(work_df[[state_col]]))
state_std <- toupper(wru::as_state_abbreviation(orig_state))

invalid_state_mask <- is.na(state_std) | !stringr::str_detect(state_std, "^[A-Z]{2}$")
invalid_state_values <- sort(unique(orig_state[invalid_state_mask & !is.na(orig_state) & orig_state != ""]))

if (length(invalid_state_values) > 0) {
  cat("Invalid/unmapped state values (up to 50 shown):\n")
  print(utils::head(invalid_state_values, 50))
}

work_df <- work_df %>%
  dplyr::mutate(state = dplyr::if_else(
    !is.na(state_std) & stringr::str_detect(state_std, "^[A-Z]{2}$"),
    state_std,
    NA_character_
  ))

# ZIP/ZCTA cleaning
zip_raw <- stringr::str_trim(as.character(work_df[[zip_col]]))
zip_digits <- stringr::str_remove_all(zip_raw, "[^0-9]")
zip_norm_name <- normalize_name(zip_col)

if (zip_norm_name %in% c("zcta", "zcta5")) {
  zcta <- dplyr::case_when(
    zip_digits == "" ~ NA_character_,
    nchar(zip_digits) <= 5 ~ stringr::str_pad(zip_digits, width = 5, side = "left", pad = "0"),
    TRUE ~ substr(zip_digits, 1, 5)
  )
} else {
  zcta <- dplyr::case_when(
    nchar(zip_digits) >= 5 ~ substr(zip_digits, 1, 5),
    nchar(zip_digits) > 0 ~ stringr::str_pad(zip_digits, width = 5, side = "left", pad = "0"),
    TRUE ~ NA_character_
  )
}

zcta[!stringr::str_detect(zcta, "^[0-9]{5}$")] <- NA_character_
work_df$zcta <- zcta

cat("Rows with missing/invalid zcta after cleaning:", sum(is.na(work_df$zcta)), "\n")

# Surname cleaning/derivation
if (!is.null(surname_col)) {
  surname <- as.character(work_df[[surname_col]])
  surname <- stringr::str_squish(stringr::str_trim(surname))
} else {
  full_name <- as.character(work_df[[name_col]])
  full_name <- stringr::str_squish(stringr::str_trim(full_name))

  # Remove one common suffix at the end for transparency
  full_name <- stringr::str_replace(
    full_name,
    regex("[,\\s]+(JR|SR|II|III|IV|V|MD|PHD|ESQ|CPA|DDS|DMD)\\.?$", ignore_case = TRUE),
    ""
  )

  pieces <- stringr::str_split(full_name, "\\s+")
  surname <- purrr::map_chr(pieces, function(x) {
    if (length(x) == 0) return(NA_character_)
    x[length(x)]
  })
}

surname <- stringr::str_squish(stringr::str_trim(surname))
surname[surname == ""] <- NA_character_
work_df$surname <- surname

cat("Rows with missing/empty surname:", sum(is.na(work_df$surname)), "\n")
```

```{r run_wru_state_loop, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
# Build WRU input
wru_input <- work_df %>%
  dplyr::transmute(id, surname, state, zcta)

n_total <- nrow(wru_input)
n_bad_surname <- sum(is.na(wru_input$surname) | wru_input$surname == "")
n_bad_state <- sum(is.na(wru_input$state) | !stringr::str_detect(wru_input$state, "^[A-Z]{2}$"))
n_bad_zcta <- sum(is.na(wru_input$zcta) | !stringr::str_detect(wru_input$zcta, "^[0-9]{5}$"))

wru_input_clean <- wru_input %>%
  dplyr::filter(
    !is.na(surname), surname != "",
    !is.na(state), stringr::str_detect(state, "^[A-Z]{2}$"),
    !is.na(zcta), stringr::str_detect(zcta, "^[0-9]{5}$")
  )

cat("Removed rows (surname):", n_bad_surname, "\n")
cat("Removed rows (state):", n_bad_state, "\n")
cat("Removed rows (zcta):", n_bad_zcta, "\n")
cat("Rows sent to WRU:", nrow(wru_input_clean), "\n")

pred_cols <- c("pred_whi", "pred_bla", "pred_his", "pred_asi", "pred_oth")

if (nrow(wru_input_clean) == 0) {
  warning("No valid rows remain after cleaning. Writing empty prediction step file.")
  prediction_step <- wru_input_clean
  for (pc in pred_cols) prediction_step[[pc]] <- numeric()
} else {
  states <- sort(unique(wru_input_clean$state))
  cat("States to score:", paste(states, collapse = ", "), "\n")

  state_results <- purrr::map(states, function(st) {
    message(sprintf("Scoring state %s ...", st))

    tryCatch({
      df_state <- wru_input_clean %>%
        dplyr::filter(state == st) %>%
        dplyr::select(id, surname, state, zcta)

      census_st <- wru::get_census_data(states = st, census.geo = "zcta", year = "2020")

      pred_st <- wru::predict_race(
        voter.file = df_state,
        census.geo = "zcta",
        census.data = census_st,
        names.to.use = "surname",
        impute.missing = TRUE,
        skip_bad_geos = TRUE
      )

      # Normalize WRU prediction column names
      names(pred_st) <- names(pred_st) %>%
        stringr::str_replace_all("\\.", "_")

      for (pc in pred_cols) {
        if (!pc %in% names(pred_st)) pred_st[[pc]] <- NA_real_
      }

      pred_st %>%
        dplyr::select(id, surname, state, zcta, dplyr::all_of(pred_cols))
    }, error = function(e) {
      warning(sprintf("State %s failed: %s", st, e$message))
      NULL
    })
  })

  prediction_step <- dplyr::bind_rows(state_results)

  if (nrow(prediction_step) == 0) {
    warning("All state loops failed or returned no predictions.")
    prediction_step <- wru_input_clean
    for (pc in pred_cols) prediction_step[[pc]] <- NA_real_
    prediction_step <- prediction_step %>% dplyr::slice(0)
  }
}

if (nrow(prediction_step) > 0) {
  prediction_step <- prediction_step %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      surname = toupper(stringr::str_squish(as.character(surname))),
      zcta5 = as.character(zcta),
      zcta5 = stringr::str_remove_all(zcta5, "[^0-9]"),
      zcta5 = dplyr::case_when(
        nchar(zcta5) >= 5 ~ substr(zcta5, 1, 5),
        nchar(zcta5) > 0 ~ stringr::str_pad(zcta5, width = 5, side = "left", pad = "0"),
        TRUE ~ NA_character_
      )
    )
} else {
  prediction_step$zcta5 <- character()
}

# Save step-style WRU predictions
out_step_path <- file.path(predictions_dir, output_file)
zipcode_export <- prediction_step %>%
  dplyr::select(zcta5, surname, dplyr::all_of(pred_cols))
haven::write_dta(zipcode_export, out_step_path)

# Merge-back for reporting only
scored_ids <- unique(prediction_step$id)
rows_scored <- sum(work_df$id %in% scored_ids)
rows_not_scored <- nrow(work_df) - rows_scored

cat("\nTotal input rows:", nrow(work_df), "\n")
cat("Rows successfully scored:", rows_scored, "\n")
cat("Rows not scored:", rows_not_scored, "\n")
cat("Prediction columns:", paste(pred_cols, collapse = ", "), "\n")
cat("Saved output file:", out_step_path, "\n")
```
